ja: ユミ、怯えて震えるような仕草が愛しくて、死んでしまうなんて。
en: Oh, Yumi... / ...your trembling, frightened ways|were so dear to me. And now you're dead.

ja: 今日、どれにしようかな?
en: Hmm, which one shall it be today~?

ja: 終日なる下部たちよ。通路が開かれた。指紋を固めよ。龍の使い手が現れた。指紋を固めよ。回避自動に近づけてはならぬ。
en: My faithful servants. The passage has been opened. Guard the Four Gates. / The Dragon Wielders have appeared. Guard the Four Gates. / Let them not near the National Diet Building.
